ranks: Odyssey (ODY, 2001-10-01): its 105 most-played of the 211 cards left (the fifth middle walk's range, round nineteen); fixed an each-player-may choice's "that-player" when its chooser is the effect's controller (Dwarven Driller, Dwarven Scorcher and Combustion Man on their controller's own permanents)

blocked.name: Bomb Squad
blocked.why: "Whenever a creature has four or more fuse counters" is a per-creature state trigger; on: "state" takes only a StaticCondition with no creature for "that creature".

blocked.name: Earnest Fellowship
blocked.why: protection takes only fixed colours, types or a filter; nothing makes each creature's protection follow its own colours.

blocked.name: Devoted Caretaker
blocked.why: No effect grants protection until end of turn; protection exists only as a static.

blocked.name: Aegis of Honor
blocked.why: The next damage from an instant or sorcery spell redirected to its controller: prevent-damage-from-chosen-source asks for a chosen source and its redirectTo can't name the source's controller.

blocked.name: Laquatus's Creativity
blocked.why: "Discards that many" is the count before the draw; thisWay "drawn" differs when a draw is replaced or the library runs short.

blocked.name: Embolden
blocked.why: The divided field and *-divided effects cover damage and counters only, not prevention.

blocked.name: Pardic Miner
blocked.why: prohibit covers spells and abilities only; no "can't play lands this turn".

blocked.name: Standstill
blocked.why: "Each of that player's opponents" for the spell's caster: each-other-opponent reads the trigger-player, which a cast-spell event doesn't set.

blocked.name: Ground Seal
blocked.why: No static stops cards in graveyards being targeted.

blocked.name: Cultural Exchange
blocked.why: No effect swaps chosen, equal-sized sets of creatures between two target players.

blocked.name: Vampiric Dragon
blocked.why: The damagedThisTurnBy filter matches the source's subtype, type or controller, not "this creature".

blocked.name: Balancing Act
blocked.why: sacrifice-all-but keeps only a fixed number, and there's no discard version.

blocked.name: Charmed Pendant
blocked.why: Nothing adds mana from the colored symbols of the card milled to pay the cost.

blocked.name: Decaying Soil
blocked.why: A threshold-gated grantsTriggered dies trigger is checked after the event, so the creature that makes the 7th card still triggers (rule 603.10a; the ruling says it shouldn't).

blocked.name: Predict
blocked.why: No way to choose a card name and compare the milled card against it.

blocked.name: Aven Shrine
blocked.why: It can't count graveyard cards with the same name as the spell that fired the trigger.

blocked.name: Verdant Succession
blocked.why: It can't search for a card with the same name as the creature that died.

blocked.name: Spiritualize
blocked.why: A delayed "whenever" can't follow a target creature; granting the trigger to the creature would give the life to its controller instead of the caster.

blocked.name: Bamboozle
blocked.why: look-and-choose can't reveal a target player's library while the caster picks two cards and that player orders the rest.

blocked.name: Diligent Farmhand
blocked.why: "Effects from spells named Muscle Burst count it as a card named Muscle Burst": nothing makes a card count as another name for a spell's count.

blocked.name: Impulsive Maneuvers
blocked.why: A coin flip per attacker setting up "the next time that creature would deal combat damage this turn" doubled or prevented: no such one-shot replacement.

blocked.name: Nefarious Lich
blocked.why: "Exile that many graveyard cards instead of damage, or lose the game" has no replacement, and the would-draw replacement doesn't cover life gain.

blocked.name: Extract
blocked.why: search-library searches only its controller's library (or a target permanent's controller's) and can't exile what it finds.

blocked.name: Mine Layer
blocked.why: "Remove all mine counters from all lands": remove-counter acts on one target only.

blocked.name: Obstinate Familiar
blocked.why: The would-draw replacement has no "you may skip that draw".

blocked.name: Skeletal Scrying
blocked.why: A spell's additional exileFromGraveyard cost takes a fixed number only, not X.

blocked.name: Catalyst Stone
blocked.why: costModification can't tell a flashback cast apart; castFrom "graveyard" would change other graveyard casts too.

blocked.name: Delaying Shield
blocked.why: The upkeep needs a separate "lose 1 unless you pay {1}{W}" for each counter removed.

blocked.name: Nantuko Shrine
blocked.why: sameNameAsTarget works only on a target slot, so nothing counts graveyard cards named like the triggering spell.

blocked.name: Rites of Initiation
blocked.why: The discard effect's anyNumber lets the player pick the cards and ignores random.

blocked.name: Aura Graft
blocked.why: attach needs a targeted destination; nothing chooses, on resolution, a permanent the Aura can legally enchant.

blocked.name: Holistic Wisdom
blocked.why: No "exile a card from your hand" activation cost, and nothing compares a target with the card the cost exiled.
